surface. The infrared radiation is replaced by ultraviolet radiation of the same intensity.
What will be the change in the kinetic energy of the photoelectrons and the rate at which they are
ejected?
Kinetic energy of photoelectrons  Rate of ejected photoelectrons
A.  increase  decrease
B.  decrease  decrease
C.  increase  constant
D.  decrease  constant
